title: Crop-Year Rate Sheet for Custom Application and Field Services
content:
Rates for Custom Application and Field Services are posted per acre for every operation except seed treating, which is posted per unit of seed. The rate that governs a pass is the rate of the programme the plan is written on.

## Rates by programme

All figures are in USD per acre, except the last column, which is in USD per unit of seed treated.

| Programme | Dry fertilizer spreading | Liquid application | Anhydrous ammonia application | Aerial application | Grid or zone soil sampling | In-season tissue sampling | Field scouting across the season | Seed treating (per unit) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Per-Acre Custom Application | 9.75 | 8.50 | 14.50 | 17.25 | 7.50 | 4.25 | 6.00 | 3.75 |
| Season Commitment Application Plan | 9.25 | 8.00 | 13.75 | 16.75 | 7.00 | 4.00 | 5.50 | 3.50 |
| Full-Service Agronomy Plan | 8.95 | 7.75 | 13.25 | 16.25 | 6.50 | 3.75 | 4.75 | 3.25 |
| Variable Rate Prescription Plan | 10.50 | 9.25 | 14.75 | 17.50 | 9.50 | 4.50 | 5.25 | 3.25 |
| Precision Partner Whole-Farm Plan | 8.50 | 7.25 | 12.75 | 15.75 | 6.00 | 3.25 | 4.00 | 3.00 |
| Certified Anhydrous Application Plan | 9.75 | 8.50 | 13.95 | 17.25 | 7.50 | 4.25 | 6.00 | 3.75 |

## Pricing basis of the sheet

Two programmes take the rate posted on the day the pass is run. The other four hold the rates for the crop year, and on those four the rates are locked at enrolment for the whole crop year.

| Programme | Pricing basis of the plan's rates | Rates locked for the crop year |
|---|---|---|
| Per-Acre Custom Application | the posted rate on the day the work is done | No |
| Season Commitment Application Plan | rates held for the crop year | Yes |
| Full-Service Agronomy Plan | rates held for the crop year | Yes |
| Variable Rate Prescription Plan | rates held for the crop year | Yes |
| Precision Partner Whole-Farm Plan | rates held for the crop year | Yes |
| Certified Anhydrous Application Plan | the posted rate on the day the work is done | No |

Note to the sheet: the rate for an operation is not uniform across the programmes and is not uniform in direction either. Aerial application, for instance, is posted at 15.75 on the Precision Partner Whole-Farm Plan and at 17.50 on the Variable Rate Prescription Plan, so the programme, and not the size of the operation, decides which column is read.
